settings.title: Settings & Prompts
settings.description:
Configure AI conversation agents, prompts, and settings.

*Note: Custom prompts provided as-is without warranty - placeholder for question must remain present.*

data.fallback_agent: Fallback AI agent (used during outage/high demand)
data.announce_model: Announce model name at the end of answers
data.enable_detailed_followup: Offer follow-up question for deeper explanations
data.followup_prompt: Follow-up question prompt text (e.g. 'Yes or No?')
data.retry_prompt: Prompt when question was not understood
data.abort_prompt: Abort announcement after second failed attempt
data.prompt_short: AI prompt for short answer (as-is, must include [question])
data.prompt_detailed: AI prompt for detailed explanation (as-is, use placeholders [question] and [previous_answer])
